title: Pointer-selected tooltip
intent: Reveal a formatted datum on pointer proximity while keeping the chart keyboard-focusable and update-safe.

source.title: Observable Plot tip and pointer interaction

ai.create: Create a UTC line chart whose nearest point reveals a tooltip containing the series name and formatted value on pointer movement.
ai.maintain: Make the tooltip sticky on selection and keep pointer, keyboard, update, and typed datum behavior aligned without rendering custom DOM inside the mark.
